notes.title: Ready Your Rifle | Sniper Elite: Resistance Will Launch On January 30th 2025
notes.content:
[h3]Attention snipers![/h3]

Intel has been intercepted and we are excited to announce that [b]Sniper Elite: Resistance will launch on January 30th 2025[/b]  and is now [b]available to pre-order[/b]. 

Check out the new release date trailer for Sniper Elite: Resistance [url=https://youtu.be/lyqDitom1QQ]here[/url]:

[previewyoutube=lyqDitom1QQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Further intel has also revealed the [b]Sniper Elite: Resistance Deluxe Edition[/b], which will include additional Season Pass content when that launches later in the year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952953/0aee1d272bd141f3e19e4c2cbf6c3b0c08649207.jpg[/img]

Skilled sharpshooters who pre-order Sniper Elite: Resistance receive a bonus new [b]Target Führer campaign mission[/b], an [b]additional weapon skin[/b], and the powerful [b]Karabiner 98 Rifle[/b]. In addition to the bonuses included with the Standard Edition, pre-ordering the Deluxe Edition will also offer the classic [b]M1911 Pistol[/b] and [b]two days early access to the game[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952953/e4957b3e910786b24d5ac60fbcf75f916bcb6a22.jpg[/img]

In Sniper Elite: Resistance, Harry Hawker, agent of the Special Operations Executive (SOE), takes the lead role for the first time in the series as he discovers an insidious new Wunderwaffe – something so powerful, it guarantees the Nazis would win the war. This new standalone story runs parallel to the events of Sniper Elite 5 and turns the attention towards the hidden war, far from the front lines, deep within the heart of occupied France.

As you would expect from Sniper Elite, the game offers [b]unparalleled sniping mechanics[/b], [b]stealth[/b] and [b]tactical third-person combat[/b]. You can also expect huge agency on how to complete your mission, with [b]optional Kill List targets, multiple infiltration and extractions points, and side missions[/b]. Sniper Elite Resistance also introduces [b]Propaganda Missions[/b], a brand-new style of side mission to the series. Locate a unique Propaganda poster in each of the main campaign’s levels to unlock a Propaganda Mission where you become a Resistance Fighter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952953/f856fa37ca81d1c8661828df206980d7835833f1.png[/img]

[h3]Game features:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Full length, standalone campaign playable in both single-player and co-op
[*] Authentic arsenal of World War II weaponry, featuring fan favourites as well as new additions
[*] Customise and upgrade weapons to fit your playstyle
[*] The trademark X-ray kill cam returns, showing you the true destructive power of each shot
[*] Engage in cat and mouse multiplayer in the fan favourite Invasion mode
[*] Once you’ve set your scope, take things online with adversarial multiplayer
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2169200/Sniper_Elite_Resistance

Stay up to date with all things Sniper Elite via our social channels on [url=https://twitter.com/SniperElite]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/sniperelitegame]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/snipereliteofficial/]Instagram[/url]. We stream most Thursdays via [url=https://www.twitch.tv/rebellion_official]Twitch[/url] and chat regularly with the wonderful Community via the official Rebellion [url=Discord.gg/Rebellion]Discord[/url] channel.

notes.title: Vive la France! | Take The Fight Behind Enemy Lines In Sniper Elite: Resistance
notes.content:
[h3]New operative. New threat. New campaign.[/h3]

Heed the call back to the battlefield soldier. You may have vanquished many a foe on the French coastline, but your mission there will continue in [b]Sniper Elite: Resistance[/b].

Watch the Sniper Elite: Resistance Reveal Trailer:

[previewyoutube=_HiIzU5yWGg;full][/previewyoutube]

You will now take on the role of [b]Harry Hawker[/b], an agent of the [b]Special Operations Executive[/b] (SOE). Intel has revealed powerful and deadly weapons known to the Axis as the [b]Wunderwaffe[/b]. An arsenal of this magnitude could surely turn the tide of the war in their favour. Your elite skills will be required to seek out key Axis targets and work together with the [b]French Resistance[/b] to destroy the Wunderwaffe once and for all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41627993/4d8a755da3d453c1a810fb4484fab40eec7a7cea.jpg[/img]

[h3]Weapons of warfare.[/h3]

Reacquaint yourself with an armoury packed to the rafters with [b]authentic World War II weapons[/b]. As well as some familar guns in your inventory, expect some new pieces that will aid in your missions success.

Once reunited with your ideal loadout, make sure to head to one of the [b]workbenches[/b] scattered around the campaign map in order to customise your rifles, secondaries and pistols to your specification.

The [b]visceral X-ray kill cam[/b] and advanced gunplay physics returns, demonstrating the unmatched destructive power of every one of your signature shots. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41627993/9c2e1f1c6bf35c8989e6fe5e1c1b922b036e631e.jpg[/img]

[h3]Become the Resistance.[/h3]

[b]Propaganda Missions[/b] are a brand-new style of side mission to the series.

Throughout the campaign discover unique propaganda posters that will allow you to step into the shoes of a [b]French Resistance[/b] fighter. With time sensitive objectives, players must sneak, snipe and shoot, taking down enemies under certain conditions to complete their mission.

Will you be up to the task?

[h3]Axis Invasion.[/h3]

[b]Axis Invasion[/b] returns to Sniper Elite: Resistance with more campaign halting escapades. Watch as your opponent scours the map in fear of your presence. Strike when they least expect, utilising your weapons and equipment to full effect. Their campaign success is in your hands, so whether you go all guns blazing or adopt a more stealth approach, only one will be determined the victor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41627993/d621bcae163cf43bc6d758f7b1f53cd69e423562.jpg[/img]

[h3]All for one and one for all![/h3]

Call upon your squad and head onto the battlefield read for combat with Multiplayer. Whether you prefer the chaos of [b]Deathmatch[/b] or [b]No-Cross[/b] or the wave based tactics of [b]Survival[/b], there is plenty of scope based carnage to be had. Compete with up to 16 players and battle it out until a champion is crowned.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2169200/Sniper_Elite_Resistance

Stay up to date with all things Sniper Elite via our social channels on [url=https://twitter.com/SniperElite]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/sniperelitegame]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/snipereliteofficial/]Instagram[/url]. We stream most Thursdays via [url=https://www.twitch.tv/rebellion_official]Twitch[/url] and chat regularly with the wonderful Community via the official Rebellion [url=Discord.gg/Rebellion]Discord[/url] channel.

notes.title: Patch 03 Available Now
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34794722/6211c6fc75f6e128735071207e070ee421cba463.png[/img]

[h1]PATCH 03 - 29th August 2019[/h1]

Hey everyone, thank you for all your feedback so far. We have implemented the following fixes:

[h1]Stability:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Addressed several low-repro stability issues that were evident during gameplay.[/list]

[h1]Gameplay:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Improvements to AI behaviour across all maps to address sticking issues or them becoming inactive. 
[*]Addressed an issue where the movie audio would not play when starting a new campaign.
[*]Addressed an issue in Kaiser Friedrich Museum where the player could become trapped.
[*]Addressed an issue in The Landwehr Canal where the player could get blocked by invisible collision.
[*]Addressed an issue in Kreuzberg HQ that would see the player teleport upon re-entering U-Bahn tunnel.
[*]Addressed an issue in Brandenburg Gate that would stop the Wolff cutscene from triggering.
[*]General gameplay improvements[/list]

[h1]Visuals:[/h1]
[list]
[*]General visual improvements and bug fixes[/list]

[h1]Other:[/h1]
[list]
[*]In Photo Mode, the Contrast and Exposure sliders allow for greater finesse.
[*]In Photo Mode, a new frame has been added.
[*]General improvements to localisation.[/list]

notes.title: Patch 01 Available Now
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34794722/6211c6fc75f6e128735071207e070ee421cba463.png[/img]

[h1]PATCH 01 - 29th May 2019[/h1]

Hey everyone, thank you for all your feedback so far. We have implemented the following fixes:

[h1]Stability:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Addressed several random crashes during gameplay.
[/list]
[h1]Gameplay:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added a classic controller configuration option that maps the Sprint to LB and Scope (hold)/Aim (half press) to LT.
[*]Addressed an issue in Saint Pierre where enemies appear to be stuck in moving animation after arriving in the truck.
[*]Addressed an issue in Schoenberg Streets where the player falls out of world while crawling and rotating between the wall and the fallen chair located inside the building present in front of the initial spawn area.
[*]Addressed an issue in St. Olibartus Church where there was an unnecessary 'Vault' prompt causing the player character to fall down and die from the wall near the ammo box present on the top floor of the church.
[*]Addressed an issue in Landwehr Canal where unnecessary traversal prompts allowed the player to access an out of bounds area.
[*]Addressed an issue in Train Yard with missing collision from the pile of concrete blocks allowing the player to hide and shoot through block present near the white coloured watchtower.
[*]Addressed an issue in Saint Pierre that allowed the player to see and shoot  enemies through the wall of the room located near the first objective building.
[*]Addressed an issue in Brandenburg Gate where the player character gets trapped behind the pillars after sprinting through the rubble located on the right of the Gate during ‘Get to the Brandenburg Gate’ objective.
[*]Reduced the FPS dips in the Arms Race environment.
[/list]
[h1]Visuals:[/h1]
[list]
[*]A new screen brightness calibration screen has been implemented.
[*]Fixed numerous camera out of world visibility issues affecting multiple environments.
[*]Fixed numerous environment popping issues affecting multiple environments.
[*]General visual improvements to St Pierre.
[/list]
[h1]Other:[/h1]
[list]
[*]The Photo Mode camera distance has been extended from 5m to 8m.
[*]General improvements to localisation.
[*]Addressed an issue that saw the cursor slide to the left automatically on a specific area of the screen after applying the '1366*768' display resolution in 'Full screen' display mode.
[*]Improved cursor positioning that would result in laggy mouse movement in menus.
[/list]

notes.title: Sniper Elite V2 Remastered is out now!
notes.content:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A_q8n7kjUnk
[h1]We've created a brand new launch trailer to celebrate this news, check it out above![/h1]

With gripping gameplay, revamped visuals and exciting new features, the trailer shows off all the improvements you can look forward to when you pick up your copy.

[i][b]Sniper Elite V2 Remastered takes the original's iconic sniping and advanced ballistics, and amplifies the game with a host of improvements and added extras. In addition to remastered visuals the game features overhauled assets, modernized rendering and much more.[/b][/i]

[b]Sniper Elite V2 Remastered[/b] also adds a versatile new [b]photo mode[/b] that lets you pause and move the action frame-by-frame, for that perfect X-ray Kill Cam shot. On top of all this, [b]Sniper Elite V2 Remastered[/b] includes all the DLC ever released for the game including the iconic [b]“Assassinate the Führer”[/b] mission, making it incredible value-for-money. 

[b]Sniper Elite V2 Remastered[/b] is priced[b] £29.99 / $34.99 / €34.99[/b] across all platforms. Steam and GOG users who already own the original Sniper Elite V2 can upgrade to [b]Sniper Elite V2 Remastered[/b] from just [b]£6.99 / $9.99 / €9.99[/b].

notes.title: REBELLION DISCLOSES TOP-SECRET INTEL ON FOUR SNIPER ELITE PROJECTS!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12455972/5bac6a503a2c7bd259b3ff865312fac2ecb4d937.png[/img]

[b]Oxford, March 14th 2019[/b] - Independent developer and publisher Rebellion today announced multiple Sniper Elite projects, including a much-demanded follow-up to the BAFTA-nominated [b]Sniper Elite 4[/b]. 

In a ‘[b]Sniper Elite Development Update[/b]’ video prepared specially for fans of the series, Rebellion CEO and Co-Founder [b]Jason Kingsley OBE[/b] confirmed for the first time that [b]FOUR[/b] Sniper Elite projects are currently in development:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12455972/0511775f698ce79dd99bdfc5c7f2411d4b83d0f9.jpg[/img]

[list] 
[*]Sniper Elite V2 Remastered will bring 1945 Berlin to current platforms with stunning new visuals and a host of new features.
[*]Sniper Elite 3 Ultimate Edition coming to the Switch in 2019.
[*]A new, standalone Sniper Elite game for VR devices is being developed in partnership with independent British studio Just Add Water, known for their work on the Oddworld and Gravity Crash series. 
[*]The next major title in the Sniper Elite series, following in the footsteps of the widely acclaimed Sniper Elite 4, is being worked on now.
[/list]
As announced in a stunning gameplay trailer, [b]Sniper Elite V2 Remastered[/b] launches on PC in 2019. Fans can return to Berlin and revisit an epic campaign set in the final moments of World War 2.  

Offering stunningly enhanced graphics, this is the visually definitive version of [b]Sniper Elite V2[/b].  It will introduce new playable characters, a brand new photo mode, expanded online multiplayer for up to 16 combatants, as well as all the content ever released for the game. [b]Sniper Elite V2 Remastered[/b] will be released both digitally and at retail later this year.   

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12455972/e238994673b20a1df56da089798023205eaf41ee.jpg[/img]

A full reveal of the new Sniper Elite game for VR will be coming later this year. More details on the development of the upcoming mainline Sniper Elite game will be released in [b]2020[/b]. 

For more information, and a [b]chance to win a Switch[/b] please visit [url]www.Sniper.com[/url]

[u][b]About Rebellion[/b][/u]

Founded in 1992, Rebellion is one of Europe's leading independent game developers and publishers. Whether it's the breathtaking intensity of Sniper Elite 4, the face-hugging terror of Aliens vs. Predator or the grindhouse frenzy of Zombie Army Trilogy, the Oxford-based studio is known for creating stand-out games that thrill players.  

[u][b]About Just Add Water[/b][/u]

Founded in 2006 by British career developer Stewart Gilray, Just Add Water (Development), Ltd is an experienced PC and console development studio specialising in work-for-hire alongside original titles. The company has partnered with a variety of the industry’s most high-profile publishers and developers, on well-loved and award-winning franchises. Clients have included Lorne Lanning’s Oddworld Inhabitants (Oddworld: Stranger’s Wrath & Oddworld: New & Tasty), Bossa Studios (I Am Bread), Codemasters (Micro Machines World Series), Bithell Games (Volume & Volume: Coda), and Rising Star Games (Lumo). Their 25+ staff are also currently working with Rebellion on a new Sniper Elite game for VR devices, and on an as-yet-unannounced title for Outright Games.

notes.title: Sniper Elite V2 Remastered FAQ
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952719/c7b1b84f621b2a8f5aba983416c8f77285d4f2c0.png[/img]

[h1]Why did we remaster Sniper Elite V2?[/h1]
Rebellion are lucky to have a passionate community of Sniper Elite V2 fans that we really wanted to give an opportunity to relive their experiences on the latest systems, with enhanced visuals and new features. We also wanted to bring Sniper Elite V2 Remastered to an audience of people who may not have had the chance to play the original Sniper Elite V2 on the previous platforms.

[h1]What’s new in Sniper Elite V2 Remastered?[/h1]
Sniper Elite V2 Remastered offers 4K and HDR on supporting platforms, beautifully updated environments, characters, weapons and vehicles, modernized rendering and post-processing effects, enhanced texturing and level geometry, a revamped lighting system, and dozens upon dozens of improvements and refinements For more info on all the announced details, head to https://www.sniper.com.

[h1]When will Sniper Elite V2 Remastered be released?[/h1]
14th May 2019

[h1]Will a pre-order be available?[/h1]
Yes, a pre-order is already available with 10% off.

[h1]Will there be a pre-load?[/h1]
Yes, a preload is available 72 hours before the games release on the 14th May 2019. This will be available on all platforms.

[h1]Will there be an upgrade for those who already own Sniper Elite V2?[/h1]
If you already own the original Sniper Elite V2 on Steam, then yes an upgrade will reduce the game to $9.99, £6.99, €9,99 *other currencies can be found via the Steam store. 

[h1]Will I be able to use my old Sniper Elite V2 saves?[/h1]
No. Due to the improvements made in the games, Sniper Elite V2 saves will not be compatible with Sniper Elite V2 Remastered.

[h1]Will the DLC from Sniper Elite V2 be available?[/h1]
All previously released DLC is included in Sniper Elite V2 Remastered without the need for additional downloads or purchases. 

[h1]If my friend owns the original Sniper Elite V2 and I have Sniper Elite V2 Remastered, can we play multiplayer together?[/h1]
No, due to the substantial improvements made, Sniper Elite V2 and Sniper Elite V2 Remastered are separate products and not compatible with each other.

[h1]Does the game support dedicated servers on Steam?[/h1]
Yes, Sniper Elite V2 Remastered supports dedicated servers via a separate download that can be found in the Tools section on Steam. 

[h1]How do I get in touch if I don’t see my question here?[/h1]
We have a helpful Sniper Elite community team and community on both the forum and Discord, where most questions can be answered. 

[b]Rebellion Discord[/b]: http://discord.gg/Rebellion 
[b]Rebellion Forum[/b]: https://forum.rebellion.co.uk/sniper

[h1]How can I find out more information about what is coming?[/h1]
To ensure you do not miss any upcoming and breaking news, be sure to sign up to our Sniper Elite newsletter, and follow our social channels.

[b]Newsletter Signup[/b]: https://www.sniper.com 
[b]Twitter[/b]: https://twitter.com/Rebellion 
[b]Facebook[/b]: https://www.facebook.com/rebelliondevelopments 
[b]YouTube[/b]: https://www.youtube.com/user/Rebellion2000ad
